title: Show current directory
description: Prints the full path of the current working directory.

title: List files
description: Lists files and directories in the current directory.

title: List all files with details
description: Includes hidden files and human-readable sizes.

title: Change directory
description: Changes the shell's current directory.

title: Go to home directory
description: Moves to your home directory.

title: Return to previous directory
description: Switches to the previous working directory.

title: Create directory
description: Creates a directory.

title: Create nested directories
description: Creates parent directories as needed.

title: Create empty file
description: Creates a file or updates its modification timestamp.

title: Copy a file
description: Copies a file to a destination.

title: Copy a directory
description: Copies a directory and its contents.

title: Move or rename
description: Moves or renames a file or directory.

title: Remove empty directory
description: Removes an empty directory.

title: Remove a file
description: Deletes the specified file. Check the path before using.
warning: Review the command and replace placeholders before using.

title: View file contents
description: Prints a file's contents in the terminal.

title: Read long text page by page
description: Opens text in a pager; press q to quit.

title: Show first lines
description: Prints the first 20 lines.

title: Show last lines
description: Prints the last 20 lines.

title: Follow a log file
description: Continuously displays new lines appended to a file; Ctrl+C stops it.

title: Identify file type
description: Reports the detected file type.

title: Disk usage of a folder
description: Shows total size of a folder.

title: Filesystem free space
description: Shows used and available space for mounted filesystems.

title: List block devices
description: Lists disks and partitions.

title: Find files by name
description: Searches recursively from the current folder for Python files.

title: Find files by type
description: Lists regular files below the current directory.

title: Find recently changed files
description: Finds files modified within roughly the last day.

title: Search text in files
description: Searches recursively, ignores case, and shows line numbers.

title: Count lines, words, bytes
description: Counts lines; use -w for words or -c for bytes.

title: Create a symbolic link
description: Creates a symbolic link pointing to a target.

title: Show file permissions
description: Displays permissions, owner, group, size, and timestamp.

title: Change file permissions
description: Adds execute permission for the file owner.
warning: Review the command and replace placeholders before using.

title: Change file owner
description: Changes ownership; requires care and may require administrator privileges.
warning: Review the command and replace placeholders before using.

title: Show current user
description: Prints the current username.

title: Show user and group IDs
description: Displays user ID, group ID, and group memberships.

title: List groups
description: Shows the groups the current user belongs to.

title: Kernel and system info
description: Displays kernel and system information.

title: Linux distribution info
description: Shows distribution name and version.

title: Show uptime
description: Shows how long the system has been running and load averages.

title: Show date and time
description: Prints the system date and time.

title: Calendar
description: Displays a calendar in the terminal.

title: Environment variables
description: Lists environment variables.

title: Show PATH
description: Displays directories searched for executables.

title: Locate executable
description: Shows how the shell resolves a command.

title: Manual page
description: Opens a command's manual page; press q to quit.

title: Search manual descriptions
description: Searches manual page summaries for a keyword.

title: List processes
description: Displays running processes.

title: Interactive process monitor
description: Shows processes and resource usage; press q to quit.

title: Check memory
description: Shows memory and swap usage.

title: Watch a command
description: Repeats a command every two seconds; Ctrl+C stops it.

title: List open files for a process
description: Shows files opened by a process; replace PID.

title: Show process tree
description: Displays processes in a tree.

title: Stop a process by PID
description: Requests a process to stop; replace PID with the correct process ID.
warning: Review the command and replace placeholders before using.

title: Refresh APT package lists
description: Refreshes package metadata on Debian/Ubuntu-based systems.

title: Upgrade installed packages
description: Installs available upgrades; review the proposed changes before confirming.
warning: Review the command and replace placeholders before using.

title: Install a package
description: Installs a package from configured repositories; replace PACKAGE.

title: Search for a package
description: Searches package names and descriptions.

title: Show package information
description: Displays metadata for a package.

title: Remove a package
description: Removes a package but may leave configuration files.
warning: Review the command and replace placeholders before using.

title: List installed packages
description: Lists installed packages.

title: Find which package owns a file
description: Looks up the package that installed a file.

title: Show service status
description: Shows status and recent log lines for a service.

title: Start a service
description: Starts a system service now.

title: Restart a service
description: Restarts a service; connected applications may be interrupted.
warning: Review the command and replace placeholders before using.

title: Enable service at boot
description: Configures a service to start at boot.

title: View system journal
description: Shows logs from the current boot.

title: Show recent service logs
description: Shows the last 100 journal entries for a service.

title: Show IP addresses
description: Displays network interfaces and IP addresses.

title: Show routes
description: Displays the routing table.

title: Test connectivity
description: Sends four ping requests; some networks block ping.

title: Check DNS lookup
description: Looks up a host using the system's configured name service.

title: Inspect listening ports
description: Lists listening TCP/UDP sockets and numeric ports.

title: Download a file
description: Downloads a URL using curl; replace with the intended URL.

title: Fetch response headers
description: Requests HTTP response headers.

title: Secure remote login
description: Connects to a remote machine; replace user and host.

title: Copy file over SSH
description: Copies a file to a remote host over SSH.

title: Show network manager devices
description: Shows network devices managed by NetworkManager.

title: Create tar archive
description: Creates a gzip-compressed tar archive.

title: Extract tar.gz archive
description: Extracts a gzip-compressed tar archive into the current directory.

title: List archive contents
description: Lists files inside an archive without extracting them.

title: Zip files
description: Creates a ZIP archive recursively; requires zip utility.

title: Unzip archive
description: Extracts a ZIP archive.

title: Sort lines
description: Sorts lines alphabetically according to the current locale.

title: Remove adjacent duplicate lines
description: Sorts then removes duplicate adjacent lines.

title: Extract first column
description: Extracts the first comma-delimited field; simple CSV only.

title: Replace text in stream
description: Prints text with replacements; does not edit the file in place.

title: Print selected fields
description: Prints the first whitespace-separated field from each line.

title: Count matching lines
description: Counts lines matching a pattern.

title: Show command history
description: Displays recent shell commands.

title: Clear terminal
description: Clears the terminal display.

title: Run last command again
description: Shell history expansion that repeats the previous command.

title: Run command in background
description: Starts a command in the background of the current shell.

title: Redirect output to file
description: Writes standard output to a file, replacing its previous contents.

title: Append output to file
description: Appends standard output to a file.

title: Pipe output to another command
description: Sends one command's output to another command's input.

title: Initialize repository
description: Creates a Git repository in the current directory.

title: Clone repository
description: Downloads a repository; replace URL with its clone URL.

title: Check working tree
description: Shows current branch and modified, staged, or untracked files.

title: Stage a file
description: Stages a file for the next commit.

title: Stage all changes
description: Stages changes in the current directory; inspect status first.

title: Commit staged changes
description: Records staged changes with a message.

title: View compact history
description: Shows the latest ten commits.

title: Show differences
description: Shows unstaged changes.

title: Show staged differences
description: Shows changes staged for commit.

title: List branches
description: Lists local branches.

title: Create a branch
description: Creates and switches to a new branch.

title: Switch branches
description: Switches to an existing branch.

title: Fetch remote changes
description: Downloads remote references without integrating them.

title: Pull remote changes
description: Fetches and integrates changes from the configured upstream.

title: Push commits
description: Uploads local commits to the configured remote.

title: View remotes
description: Lists remote names and URLs.

title: Temporarily save changes
description: Stores working changes for later retrieval.

title: Restore a file
description: Discards unstaged changes to a file; use carefully.
warning: Review the command and replace placeholders before using.

title: Undo a commit safely
description: Creates a new commit that reverses a previous commit.
warning: Review the command and replace placeholders before using.

title: Show a commit
description: Displays details and changes for a commit.

title: Search tracked files
description: Searches tracked files for TODO.

title: Add remote
description: Adds a remote named origin.

title: Show ignored files
description: Includes ignored files in status output.

title: Check Python version
description: Displays the Python 3 version.

title: Run a Python file
description: Runs a Python script with Python 3.

title: Create virtual environment
description: Creates an isolated Python environment in .venv.

title: Activate venv (Linux/macOS)
description: Activates a project's virtual environment in Bash/Zsh.

title: Install dependencies
description: Installs packages listed in requirements.txt.

title: Install a package
description: Installs a package into the active Python environment.

title: List installed packages
description: Lists installed packages in the selected environment.

title: Save dependency list
description: Writes installed package versions to a requirements file.

title: Compile-check Python syntax
description: Checks whether a Python file compiles without running it.

title: Run unit tests
description: Discovers and runs unittest tests.

title: Start Python REPL
description: Opens the interactive Python interpreter; type exit() to leave.

title: Install editable project
description: Installs a package project in editable mode when packaging metadata exists.

title: Format with Black
description: Formats Python files if Black is installed.

title: Lint with Ruff
description: Checks Python code with Ruff if installed.

title: Check Node.js version
description: Displays the Node.js version.

title: Check npm version
description: Displays the npm version.

title: Initialize Node project
description: Creates a default package.json.

title: Install project dependencies
description: Installs dependencies from package.json.

title: Run a JavaScript file
description: Runs a JavaScript file using Node.js.

title: Start npm script
description: Runs the dev script if defined in package.json.

title: Start local Python web server
description: Serves the current directory over HTTP on port 8000; use only for trusted local development.

title: Check HTTP response headers
description: Requests response headers from a web server.

title: Validate JSON with Python
description: Pretty-prints valid JSON or reports parsing errors.

title: Check Java version
description: Displays the Java runtime version.

title: Check Java compiler
description: Displays the Java compiler version.

title: Compile Java class
description: Compiles Main.java into bytecode.

title: Run compiled Java class
description: Runs the Main class from the current classpath.

title: Create runnable JAR
description: Packages class files into a JAR with Main as the entry point.

title: Show Docker version
description: Displays Docker client version.

title: List running containers
description: Lists running containers.

title: List all containers
description: Lists running and stopped containers.

title: List local images
description: Lists locally stored images.

title: View container logs
description: Displays logs for a container.

title: Compose up
description: Starts services in the current Compose project in the background.

title: Compose stop
description: Stops and removes resources created by the Compose project; review volumes before using options that delete them.
warning: Review the command and replace placeholders before using.

description: Opens a SQLite database file; requires sqlite3 CLI.

description: Exports a PostgreSQL database; authentication and connection settings may be required.

title: Check SQLite integrity
description: Runs SQLite's integrity check on the selected database.

title: Check Git version
description: Displays the installed Git version.

title: Check compiler version
description: Displays GCC compiler version if installed.

title: Check disk usage of current folder
description: Shows the total disk usage of the current folder.

title: Find large files (top-level)
description: Shows 20 largest entries by size under the current folder; output can include directories and files.

title: List USB devices
description: Lists USB devices; may require usbutils.

title: List PCI devices
description: Lists PCI devices; may require pciutils.

title: Show loaded kernel modules
description: Lists currently loaded kernel modules.

title: Show kernel messages
description: Displays kernel messages at error and warning levels; permissions vary.
